source_authored_argument.native_input: R009 admits a same-function rescue set without requiring statistical independence, while retaining activation, selection, state, common-cause and added-loss premises.
source_authored_argument.source_to_receiver_interface: The already described multiple-reference clock service supplies the alternate reference and selection/synchronization roles that the old D04 exception said were absent. Its consumer still requires the same physical interval and failure-response function.
source_authored_argument.guard: Compare reference paths for the same required interval function. The alternate survives the named reference fault and is accepted by a functioning applicable selection path; local drift, communication, remaining references and response assumptions are retained.
source_authored_argument.changed_warrant: Multiple references alone cannot earn protection credit. R009 separates a possible accepted rescue from a replicated but unusable reference or a shared selection failure. This qualifies the evidence for selecting/trusting that D04 clock-service branch, without deriving the interval theorem.
source_authored_argument.strongest_defense: The source defers implementation details and does not prove thresholds, coverage or net improvement. That defeats those stronger conclusions. It does not make the explicitly described reference and selection architecture absent.
source_authored_argument.countercase: An alternate with the same relevant fault, an unacceptable uncertainty interval or a broken shared selector does not rescue the required function. Choosing logical order instead is not a rescue if the consumer actually requires a physical-time interval.
source_authored_argument.nontrigger: A sufficient local sequence, adequate existing total log, or single supported time reference with accepted outage can be the complete economical choice.
source_authored_argument.unresolved: Actual joint fault law, selector soundness/coverage, transfer dynamics, availability and maintenance cost; no field reliability estimate or positive net benefit follows.
source_authored_argument.reentry: Reassess if the same-function correspondence, source architecture, bound/failure-response contract or relevant fault model changes.
source_authored_argument.author_exposure: Same exposed continuing author; not an independent review.
source_authored_argument.probability_limit: A nonempty possible rescue set alone does not establish positive probability or a positive net reliability increment. The contribution constrains the claimed protection and comparison; no weights are assigned to real fault worlds.
source_authored_argument.authority: Current exposed A006 author judgment; no independent acceptance or qualification.

source_authored_argument.native_input: R040 explicitly includes physical and technological diversity. It qualifies targeted causal separation and residual shared specification, inputs, oracle, adjudication and maintenance burdens.
source_authored_argument.source_to_receiver_interface: The distinct reference technologies and actual shared selection/synchronization role form the existing D04 receiving object. No newly invented diverse clock deployment is required.
source_authored_argument.guard: Both paths address the same bound-bearing time function; the claimed advantage is restricted to named differing failure causes and a valid acceptance path. Merely distinct suppliers, labels or clock readings are insufficient.
source_authored_argument.changed_warrant: Credit for common-mode protection is bounded by the actual causal dimensions separated. Source variety or mutual agreement does not prove absolute-time correctness or independence; shared decision and specification failures remain.
source_authored_argument.strongest_defense: A source description does not establish exhaustive independence or success of the complete clock implementation. R040 needs neither for its qualitative restriction of a diversity claim. Native scope includes the named technological channels.
source_authored_argument.countercase: Different reference types can share a wrong acceptance rule or fail to cover the same required function; agreement among them can then be inadequate evidence.
source_authored_argument.nontrigger: A single adequate reference or accepted interruption may dominate additional diversity once the objective and burden are fixed.
source_authored_argument.unresolved: Magnitude of common-mode reduction, joint error frequencies, rejection performance and overall benefit remain unknown.
source_authored_argument.reentry: Reassess a changed causal-diversity claim, reference function, common acceptance mechanism or contrary failure account.
source_authored_argument.author_exposure: Same exposed continuing author; not an independent review.
source_authored_argument.dependence_limit: Different documented failure modes are a qualitative causal distinction, not a calibrated joint distribution or a proof of statistical independence. This author input makes no universal claim of diversity superiority.
source_authored_argument.authority: Current exposed A006 author judgment; no independent acceptance or qualification.

source_authored_argument.native_input: R051 distinguishes fixed ideal OR addition from a changed architecture with voters, transfer or synchronization. Rescue can coexist with newly introduced loss and cost; dependence alone cannot make an ideal OR addition worse.
source_authored_argument.source_to_receiver_interface: Take the described varied-reference design and analytically remove the additional reference-class capability while retaining the same required physical-time function and the remaining paths. Reintroducing that capability is the bounded addition being assessed. The restricted comparator is not asserted to satisfy every fault case, nor to be a historical deployed predecessor. This uses existing named parts; it does not invent a new clock application.
source_authored_argument.guard: Hold the required interval and permitted failure response fixed. The added path must supply an accepted rescue for a named reference-failure case. Compare the actual polling, selection, synchronization, reference upkeep and uncertainty responsibilities that differ. A selector may already exist in the restricted design; do not charge the entire existing selector as a newly introduced serial component or assert that every extra reference adds one.
source_authored_argument.changed_warrant: A possible rescue against one reference fault does not establish monotone improvement of the complete time service. D04’s choice/protection argument must distinguish that rescue from any actual added-loss or burden path in the stated comparison. The source names the relevant control roles but does not establish that the added reference causes harm. R051 supplies a partial evaluation/scope constraint while the sign and size of the total effect remain unknown.
source_authored_argument.strongest_defense: There is no full implementation, failure-rate law, actual historical design transition or evaluated net increment. Those absences prevent a numerical or operational recommendation. They do not prohibit a declared analytical removal comparison of a real described architecture under the existing composition standard.
source_authored_argument.countercase: For an ideal loss-free OR addition, the augmented success set includes the baseline success set even with dependent paths. A harmful augmentation example must name an actual added-loss interaction; correlated failures alone do not suffice. The actual source is not asserted to exhibit that harm.
source_authored_argument.nontrigger: No redesign, extra reference or new controller is required when the existing single service or admitted outage already satisfies the consumer.
source_authored_argument.unresolved: Whether the named enrichment improves, preserves or worsens actual whole-service reliability, availability or total cost is not established. The source does not pin all rejection/selection details.
source_authored_argument.independent_adjudication_receiving: CLOCK_ADJUDICATION_001 was actually written by the independent reviewer before this substantive response. Its guarded argument was critically read after the author had separately read the source and full R051 native/current/profile. Agreement does not make this component an independent review.
source_authored_argument.reentry: Reassess if the compared parts, required function, acceptance path, added interaction or empirical cost/fault evidence changes.
source_authored_argument.author_exposure: Same exposed continuing author; not an independent review.
source_authored_argument.finite_control_link: FC01 preserves loss-free OR monotonicity. FC03 shows that an imperfect failover-only guard can reduce rescue without harming primary success. FC04 requires an explicitly changed common-gate architecture for its loss witness and does not attribute that topology to Spanner.
source_authored_argument.authority: Current exposed A006 author judgment; no independent acceptance or qualification.
